style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent spring-editorial womenswear detail-page system across the whole set. Fixed palette: paper ground #F7F2E9, ink text #2C2C2C, matcha accent #A9BC86, citrus panel #F6FAD9, info field #F1EFEB. Tone warm-neutral, held across every frame. Typography: one pairing only, a high-contrast serif for section titles wrapped in hash marks, plus a light geometric sans-serif for body and labels; Chinese copy always wrapped in corner brackets; highlighter blocks in #A9BC86 sit only behind short lead-in phrases; letter-spaced small-caps English used as a divider strip. Background system: fine 6mm micro-grid paper texture with flat solid panels, never photographic gradients or bloom. Lighting system: soft north-window daylight, front-left key, 5200-5500K, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows, no hard speculars. Surface system: matte paper and matte cloth, no gloss table tops. Layout system: narrow mobile detail column, wide margins, staircased image offsets, one accent rectangle offset behind each lookbook frame, thin rules under every section label, three-step index rows. Icon system: none, except one small flat fruit pictogram used once. Presentation rules: fabric drape, print scale, tier volumes and topstitch relief stay true to the reference; model cropped above the brow so no face identity reads; the garment is always grounded by a contact shadow. No drift: no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented certifications, prices, dates or measurements.
